steps.name: app-shell
steps.summary: Added cached getSessionContext(): SessionContext|null, token-based AppSidebar/PathAwareAppHeader/AppHeader(onUploadClick optional, default emits finsight:upload-click)/Badge/ReadOnlyBanner/TrialEndingBanner shell, and get_transaction_months RPC for latest month links.

steps.name: upload-dialog
steps.summary: Added UploadDialog(cardLabels,onUploadStarted), DashboardUploads(initialJobs), UploadProgressCard(initialJob), ProgressBar(value,label), and UploadSummary(summary,cardLabelMismatchWarning); dashboard/page.tsx queries upload_jobs for card labels and pending/parsing/categorizing/needs_mapping jobs, with insight card slot intentionally empty below summaries.

steps.name: dashboard
steps.summary: Added dashboard RPCs get_dashboard_summary/get_dashboard_category_breakdown/get_dashboard_monthly_flow/get_dashboard_top_merchants, typed wrappers fetchDashboard*, POST /api/signals/[id]/dismiss, and /dashboard month selection via ?month=YYYY-MM with KPI/category/flow/merchant/insight panels.

steps.name: transactions
steps.summary: 거래 목록 RPC get_transactions_page/get_transactions_summary(둘 다 p_search·p_categories는 default null이라 TS에서는 undefined로 생략)와 래퍼 src/lib/transactions/queries.ts(fetchTransactionsPage/fetchTransactionsSummary), 분류 수정 라우트 POST /api/transactions/category({merchantNormalized, category} — user_category_overrides만 upsert), /dashboard/transactions 화면(URL 파라미터 month·q·category(다중)·page, 20건 단위)과 TransactionCategorySelect를 추가함

steps.name: uploads-history
steps.summary: Added MappingTrial.dateFormat/dateFormatResolvedBy, upload_jobs.date_format/date_format_resolved_by/created_at, full-file worker persistence, and /dashboard/uploads history with needs_mapping links plus expired-safe delete confirmation.

steps.name: manual-mapping
steps.summary: Added GET /api/uploads/[id]/preview returning {header, rows<=10, mappingAttemptCount, remainingAttempts}, no-entitlement mapping/preview comments, and /dashboard/uploads/[id]/mapping manual column picker with retry count and 422 cancel flow.
